name: AI proxy - interest - baselines vs T2

items.prompt: What amount is simple interest calculated on each period?
options: The principal plus all past interest
Only the most recent interest payment

items.prompt: What makes compound interest grow faster than simple interest over time?
options: The interest rate must increase every period

items.prompt: At the same positive rate and starting principal, why does the compound-interest balance pull farther ahead over repeated periods?
options: Compound interest stops using the principal
The amount that earns compound interest keeps growing
